# JMA Solutions

JMA Solutions is a Government Relations Services company. jma solutions is a dynamic and thriving management services firm consisting of knowledgeable and seasoned professionals. They are committed to providing outstanding customer support that exceeds their clients' expectations and furthers their mission. JMA Solutions employs 47 people (+9.1% YoY, +7 people) and has an annual revenue of $767.5M, founded in 2005. Headquartered in Washington, District of Columbia, United States, with an office in Egg Harbor Township. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Bangladesh.

## About

Headquartered in Washington, DC, JMA Solutions is an award-winning consulting firm with more than 20 years of experience delivering extraordinary customer service to our government clients. JMA Solutions is a Service-Disabled Veteran and Certified Woman-Owned, ISO 9001:2015, and CMMI Services Maturity Level 3 Certified company. We offer access to a network of subject matter experts who collaborate with our clients on critical short-and long-term projects. JMA's reputation is built on our commitment to our client's values and our reputation for exceeding their business needs with exceptional results. Many of our 150+ qualified professionals hold multiple certifications including Program Management Professional (PMP), Certified Information Security Managers (CISM), Lean Six Sigma, Certified Public Accountant (CPA), and top-level security clearances. 

JMA's core capabilities include Program and Project Management, Air Traffic Management, Aviation Safety Management, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Engineering Services, SharePoint Development, Software Development, Cyber Security, Financial and Acquisition Management, and Professional and Technical Training.
